```{r}

#| warning: false
todays_date <- substr(lubridate::today(), 1, 10)
```

**Updated: `r todays_date`**

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(htmltools)

events <- read_xlsx("Events.xlsx") |>
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) |> 
  filter(Date > as.Date(todays_date))

make_month_html <- function(yr, mo, evt) {
  first     <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", yr, mo))
  n_days    <- as.integer(lubridate::days_in_month(first))
  start_dow <- lubridate::wday(first, week_start = 1)  # Mon=1 … Sun=7

  header <- tags$h3(format(first, "%B %Y"),
                    style = "margin-top:2rem")

  dow_headers <- tags$tr(
    lapply(c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"), \(d)
      tags$th(d, style = "width:14.28%; text-align:center; padding:4px;
                           background:#f0f0f0; border:1px solid #ddd;"))
  )

  cells <- c(
    replicate(start_dow - 1,
              tags$td(style = "border:1px solid #ddd;"),
              simplify = FALSE),
    lapply(seq_len(n_days), function(day) {
      day_events <- evt[lubridate::day(evt$Date) == day, ]

      event_html <- if (nrow(day_events) > 0) {
        lapply(seq_len(nrow(day_events)), function(i) {
          e <- day_events[i, ]
          links <- tagList(
            if (!is.na(e[["Agenda Link"]]) &&
                nzchar(e[["Agenda Link"]]))
              tags$a("Agenda", href = e[["Agenda Link"]],
                     style = "font-size:0.7em; margin-right:4px;"),
            if (!is.na(e[["Registration Link"]]) &&
                nzchar(e[["Registration Link"]]))
              tags$a("Reg", href = e[["Registration Link"]],
                     style = "font-size:0.7em;")
          )
          tags$div(
            tags$strong(e[["Title"]], style = "font-size:0.8em;"),
            tags$br(), links,
            style = "background:#ddeeff; border-radius:3px;
                     padding:2px 4px;
                     margin-bottom:2px;"
          )
        })
      } else NULL

      tags$td(
        tags$div(day, style = "font-size:0.75em; color:#888;
                               text-align:right;"),
        tagList(event_html),
        style = "border:1px solid #ddd; vertical-align:top; padding:4px;
                 min-height:60px; width:14.28%;"
      )
    })
  )

  rows <- list()
  while (length(cells) > 0) {
    chunk <- cells[seq_len(min(7, length(cells)))]
    cells <- cells[-seq_len(min(7, length(cells)))]
    if (length(chunk) < 7)
      chunk <- c(chunk, replicate(7 - length(chunk),
                   tags$td(style = "border:1px solid #ddd;"),
                   simplify = FALSE))
    rows <- c(rows, list(tags$tr(tagList(chunk))))
  }

  tagList(
    header,
    tags$table(
      tags$thead(dow_headers),
      tags$tbody(tagList(rows)),
      style = "width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; table-layout:fixed;"
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

events_sorted <- events |> arrange(Date)

event_items <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(events_sorted)),
  function(i) {
    e <- events_sorted[i, ]
    
    meta_parts <- c(
      format(e$Date, "%d %B %Y"),
      if (!is.na(e$Organization) && nzchar(e$Organization))
        e$Organization,
      if (!is.na(e$Location) && nzchar(e$Location))
        e$Location,
      if (!is.na(e$Time) && nzchar(e$Time))
        e$Time,
      if (!is.na(e$Fee) && nzchar(as.character(e$Fee)))
        paste0("Fee: ", e$Fee)
    )

    links <- tagList(
      if (!is.na(e[["Agenda Link"]]) && nzchar(e[["Agenda Link"]]))
        tags$a("Agenda", href = e[["Agenda Link"]],
               style = "margin-right:8px;"),
      if (!is.na(e[["Registration Link"]]) &&
          nzchar(e[["Registration Link"]]))
        tags$a("Registration", href = e[["Registration Link"]])
    )
    
    tags$li(
      tags$strong(e$Title),
      tags$br(),
      tags$span(paste(meta_parts, collapse = " · "),
                style = "color:#555; font-size:0.9em;"),
      tags$br(),
      links,
      style = "margin-bottom:0.8em;"
    )
  })

htmltools::tags$ul(tagList(event_items),
                   style = "list-style:none; padding-left:0;")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

months_with_events <- events |>
  mutate(yr = lubridate::year(Date), mo = lubridate::month(Date)) |>
  distinct(yr, mo) |>
  arrange(yr, mo)

cal_html <- purrr::pmap(months_with_events, function(yr, mo) {
  month_events <- events |>
    filter(lubridate::year(Date) == yr,
           lubridate::month(Date) == mo)
  make_month_html(yr, mo, month_events)
})

htmltools::tagList(cal_html)
```
